model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата съдържа три графики: една в горната част (Figure 4) и две в долната част (Figure 5, лява и дясна), като всички илюстрират промени по слоевете на модела.

**Figure 4** показва средните абсолютни стойности преди и след gating. Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 22, с етикети на стойности 0, 5, 10, 15 и 20. Оста Y няма изрично текстово обозначение, но скалата е линейна с видими стойности 0 и 1. Видими са две линии: едната е синя пунктирана линия, а другата е зелена плътна линия. И двете линии следват много сходна траектория — стойностите са близки до 0 за слоевете от 0 до приблизително 5, след което рязко нарастват около слой 6, достигайки стойност около 1, и остават относително стабилни с леки колебания до последния слой.

**Figure 5 (лява графика)** е озаглавена „Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2". Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" с линейна скала от 0 до приблизително 22, с етикети на 0, 5, 10, 15 и 20. Оста Y е обозначена като „Sparsity Ratio" с линейна скала от 0.0 до 1.0, с интервали през 0.2. Легендата показва три линии: синя пунктирана линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03"; зелена плътна линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44"; и оранжева пунктирана линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". Синята пунктирана линия остава близо до 0 през целия диапазон на слоевете. Зелената плътна линия започва с висока стойност около 0.95 при слой 0, рязко спада до около 0.3 при слой 5, след което колебае между приблизително 0.2 и 0.5 до последния слой. Оранжевата пунктирана линия следва подобна тенденция на зелената, но с по-ниски стойности — започва около 0.85 при слой 0, спада до около 0.15 при слой 5 и колебае между приблизително 0.1 и 0.45 до края.

**Figure 5 (дясна графика)** е озаглавена „Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3". Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" с линейна скала от 0 до приблизително 22, с етикети на 0, 5, 10, 15 и 20. Оста Y е обозначена като „Sparsity Ratio" с линейна скала от 0.0 до 0.8, с интервали през 0.2. Легендата показва три линии: синя пунктирана линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003"; зелена плътна линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126"; и оранжева пунктирана линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080". Синята пунктирана линия остава много близо до 0 през целия диапазон. Зелената плътна линия започва с висока стойност около 0.7 при слой 0, рязко спада до около 0.05 при слой 5, след което остава на ниски стойности с леки колебания до края. Оранжевата пунктирана линия следва подобна тенденция — започва около 0.55 при слой 0, спада до близо 0 при слой 5 и остава на ниски нива с минимални колебания до последния слой.
model_annotations.Chinese:
**Figure 4:** This figure shows the mean absolute values before and after gating across layers of a network. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis appears to represent mean absolute values on a linear scale, with visible tick marks at 0 and 1. There are at least two lines in the plot. One line, appearing in blue with a dashed style, remains relatively flat and close to 0 across most layers, then shows a sharp spike near layer 6, rising to approximately 1, before returning to near 0 for the remaining layers. Another line, appearing in green or orange with a dashed style, follows a similar overall pattern. The caption notes that the baseline and post-gating values are similar.

**Figure 5 (shared axes description):** Both the left and right panels share the same axis structure. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale. Both panels contain three lines representing sparsity ratio before gate, sparsity ratio after gate, and sparsity ratio after average gate.

**Figure 5, Left Panel (Threshold 1e-2):** This panel shows the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2. The blue dashed line represents the sparsity ratio before gate with an average of 0.03; it remains very low and relatively flat across all layers, staying near 0. The green dashed line represents the sparsity ratio after gate with an average of 0.44; it starts high at approximately 1.0 at layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.3 by layer 5, fluctuates between roughly 0.2 and 0.5 through the middle layers, and shows some variation through layer 20. The orange dashed line represents the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average of 0.33; it follows a broadly similar pattern to the green line but at generally lower values, starting near 0.8 at layer 0, dropping to around 0.2–0.3 by layer 5, and remaining in the range of approximately 0.1 to 0.4 across subsequent layers.

**Figure 5, Right Panel (Threshold 1e-3):** This panel shows the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-3. The y-axis ranges from 0.0 to approximately 0.8. The blue dashed line represents the sparsity ratio before gate with an average of 0.003; it remains essentially at 0 across all layers. The green dashed line represents the sparsity ratio after gate with an average of 0.126; it starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, drops steeply to near 0.05 by around layer 5, and then remains low with minor fluctuations through layer 20. The orange dashed line represents the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average of 1.080 (as labeled); it starts at approximately 0.6 at layer 0, drops to near 0 by layer 5, and remains close to 0 for the remaining layers, with slight fluctuations.
model_annotations.English:
**Figure 4:** This plot illustrates the mean absolute values before and after gating across layers of a network. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis appears to represent mean absolute values on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 1.2. There are two lines visible: one shown in blue (solid) and one in green (dashed). Both lines remain relatively close to 0 for the initial layers (0 through approximately 5), then show a brief spike around layer 6, after which they generally remain low with slight fluctuations through the remaining layers. Near layer 15 and beyond, there appears to be a modest increase in one of the lines reaching values around 0.2–0.4. The caption notes that the baseline and post-gating values are similar.

**Figure 5, Left Panel (Threshold 1e-2):** This plot shows the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2 across network layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" on a linear scale from 0 to approximately 23, with ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0. Three lines are shown. The blue dashed line represents "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," which remains near 0 across all layers. The green dashed line represents "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," which starts high (approximately 0.9–1.0) at layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.2 by layer 5, fluctuates between approximately 0.2 and 0.5 through the middle layers, and shows some variation in later layers. The orange solid line represents "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," which follows a broadly similar pattern to the green line but at generally lower values, starting near 0.8 at layer 0, dropping to around 0.1–0.2 by layer 5, and remaining in the range of approximately 0.1–0.4 through subsequent layers.

**Figure 5, Right Panel (Threshold 1e-3):** This plot shows the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-3 across network layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" on a linear scale from 0 to approximately 23, with ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8. Three lines are shown. The blue dashed line represents "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," which remains near 0 across all layers. The green dashed line represents "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," which starts at approximately 0.6–0.8 at layer 0, drops steeply to near 0 by around layer 5, and remains close to 0 with minor fluctuations through the remaining layers. The orange solid line represents "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 1.080" (as labeled), which follows a similar pattern to the green line, starting high around 0.5–0.7 at layer 0, declining sharply to near 0 by layer 5, and remaining near 0 thereafter with occasional small increases.
model_annotations.German:
**Figure 4:** Dieses Diagramm zeigt die mittleren Absolutwerte vor und nach dem Gating über verschiedene Schichten eines Netzwerks. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet und erstreckt sich auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 5, 10, 15 und 20. Die y-Achse zeigt die mittleren Absolutwerte auf einer linearen Skala, mit sichtbaren Werten von etwa 0 bis knapp über 1. Es sind zwei Linien dargestellt: Eine blaue durchgezogene Linie und eine grün-gestrichelte Linie, die beide einen sehr ähnlichen Verlauf aufweisen. Beide Linien beginnen bei Layer 0 mit niedrigen Werten nahe 0, bleiben bis etwa Layer 5 relativ niedrig, steigen dann bei Layer 6 sprunghaft auf einen Wert von etwa 1 an, fallen danach wieder ab und schwanken für die restlichen Schichten auf einem moderaten Niveau zwischen etwa 0,2 und 0,5, mit einem leichten Anstieg gegen Ende bei den letzten Layern.

**Figure 5 (links):** Dieses Diagramm zeigt die „Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output" mit einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2 über die Schichten des Netzwerks. Beide Diagramme in Figure 5 teilen dieselbe x-Achsenstruktur: Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, linear skaliert von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 5, 10, 15 und 20. Die y-Achse ist jeweils mit „Sparsity Ratio" beschriftet. Im linken Diagramm reicht die y-Achse von 0,0 bis 1,0 auf einer linearen Skala. Es sind drei Linien dargestellt. Die blaue durchgezogene Linie (sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03) verläuft nahezu konstant bei sehr niedrigen Werten nahe 0 über alle Schichten hinweg. Die grüne gestrichelte Linie (sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44) beginnt bei Layer 0 mit einem hohen Wert von etwa 0,95, fällt dann steil ab auf etwa 0,3 bei Layer 5, schwankt danach zwischen etwa 0,2 und 0,5 und zeigt bei Layer 6 einen lokalen Tiefpunkt bei etwa 0,2, bevor sie in den späteren Schichten wieder auf Werte um 0,4 bis 0,5 ansteigt. Die orange gepunktete Linie (sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33) folgt einem ähnlichen Muster wie die grüne Linie, beginnt ebenfalls hoch bei etwa 0,85, fällt ab und verläuft in den mittleren und späteren Schichten tendenziell etwas unterhalb der grünen Linie, mit Werten zwischen etwa 0,15 und 0,45.

**Figure 5 (rechts):** Dieses Diagramm zeigt die „Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output" mit einem Schwellenwert von 1e-3. Die y-Achse ist mit „Sparsity Ratio" beschriftet und reicht von 0,0 bis etwa 0,8 auf einer linearen Skala. Es sind drei Linien dargestellt. Die blaue durchgezogene Linie (sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003) verläuft nahezu konstant bei Werten sehr nahe 0 über alle Schichten. Die grüne gestrichelte Linie (sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126) beginnt bei Layer 0 mit einem Wert von etwa 0,7, fällt dann steil ab und erreicht bei etwa Layer 5–6 Werte nahe 0, verbleibt danach auf niedrigem Niveau zwischen etwa 0 und 0,1 für die restlichen Schichten. Die orange gepunktete Linie (sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 1.080 – wie in der Legende angegeben) folgt einem ähnlichen Verlauf wie die grüne Linie, beginnt bei etwa 0,55 bei Layer 0, fällt steil ab und bleibt in den späteren Schichten auf sehr niedrigen Werten nahe 0.
